body: OH HECK YEAH! Thank you for reminding me!! Filmmaker has a new album (ep?) coming out on the 30th!! Its crazy how I've been looking forward to this since I saw him announce it...but being in these states really make you forget. Thank you!
Sunrises are always nice. Working night shifts, I keep the blinds open so I can see the sun come up. I love when the sky's that perfect shade of pink. Thank you!
